name: fullstack-kit
title_zh: 9 个技能打包成一套，从零搭到能部署的全栈样板间
tagline_zh: 别一个个找技能了。这一包覆盖前端、后端、数据库、部署、测试、文档，装完就有能跑的项目骨架，改改就能上线。
tagline_en: Stop hunting skills one by one. This pack covers frontend, backend, DB, deploy, test, docs—get a runnable.
why_zh: 不是散装清单，是配好对的组合拳：每个技能知道同包兄弟的存在，生成代码时自动衔接接口、模型和部署脚本。
why_en: Not a loose list but a matched set: each skill knows its siblings, so generated code links APIs, models, and deploy.
limit_zh: 只认 Node.js + TypeScript 技术栈，不含 React Native 或桌面端。
limit_en: Node.js + TypeScript only; no React Native/desktop. Outputs scaffold & runnable code—no ops tuning, no security hardening, no cloud provider pick.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

title_en: 9 skills in one kit: full-stack from scaffold to deploy
